steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: ...What's the situation?

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: We've already tracked down Miss Brynley, but... the mercenaries are understandably not giving this their best. However, going by how long it's been, she should be almost out of ammunition.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Any news on Tila's end?

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Helena and the miner took the money into the energy tower, and... neither of them came out.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: So they disappeared without a trace, right in front of everyone? There must be another exit. Tell Tila to keep looking.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: What about Woody? Has he left yet?

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Mr. Bianchi... hasn't left the plate. It seems he's effectively given up on their initial escape plan.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: After all, according to Tila's report, he was planning to hide in the mountains with the miner once everything was over.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Where did you go, Woody...

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: He... He's heading toward us.

steps.name: Secretary
steps.text: Should we send someone to intercept him?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Forget it. Let him come. If he insists on coming, no one can stop him.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Liskarm, there's a burning roadblock up ahead. I can't drive past it. We'll have to walk.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Are those... Blacksteel transports?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Was it Woodrow... or Jessica...?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: At the very least, that tells us that not everyone was inside when the energy tower exploded.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Wait, Liskarm... There's news from command.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Warning, all fireteams. The current situation is that, after the recent explosion, the target engineer's status is unknown and Target Helena is missing.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: God...

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: HQ's orders are to give up on Target Woodrow and focus on capturing Target Jessica. The target is currently in an abandoned alley on the eastern side of the mine.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Liskarm... What do we do...?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: There has to be something we can do... Our team knows the mine better than anybody else. Let's just try to make it to her side ASAP.

spans.text: we can do... Our team knows the mine better than anybody else. Let's just try to make it to her side ASAP.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: You got here much sooner than I expected... Woody.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Every last building on the way was empty. Wasn't much to do but come find you.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Are you blaming me for it?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Anyone else more deserving? Sometimes, a man bears sin not 'cause of something he's done, but 'cause of something he didn't.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Then you should've shot that bullet of yours decades ago.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: But you chose to flee. Why?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Because after a long silence, my godforsaken empathy finally realized that another Sankta had showed up by my side again. It was you.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I was a mess, Woody. Empathizing with me must've felt terrible.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What was I supposed to do? It's the nature of all Sankta. We share everything, always.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: And compared to what I read from your brain? What I had to go through at that POW camp might've been a walk in the park.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: What a cruel fate. You despise me so much, yet not even my pain can bring you joy.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Reporting. Jessica spotted. Sharing coordinates.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: The target is heading outside the mines. She has a heavy energy cannon, a semi-auto assault rifle... and a handgun of unknown make.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: She's carrying all that by herself?

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Oh, right. She also has a heavy shield on her back. The kind that can be used as carriage if necessary.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Well, that's something. Looks like after all these years, our princess has gotten pretty... remarkable.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: How's she doing? Does she look like she could put up a huge fight? It's easy to spook a cornered thief. They get jumpy if you pull anything.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: Hm... She seems kinda calm. She's just walking straight ahead, not doing anything.
In the alley, the girl carries her weapons and advances arduously through the blizzard. The dilapidated walls on the sides of the streets slowly pass her by.
That is, until she reaches a fork. She freezes there for a brief moment, then tugs her collar and turns onto the path where she must walk against the wind to proceed.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Time was frozen in that POW camp. But outside, the war kept raging.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: That's right. After you two were taken prisoner, I took even more men to even vaster battlefields.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: In January, we had to cross the river against heavy cannon fire. In August, we had to defend our position in a scorching hot desert, ceding not even an inch to the enemy.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Sometimes, we proved victorious, and we stepped forward over the bodies of our enemies. Other times, we found ourselves on the back foot, and we retreated past the bodies of our friends.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: And sometimes, things got even worse. Sometimes, I had to sacrifice some to save the others.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Just like what you did to me and him.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Right, I've done it plenty of times. Not just to you two, but to who-knows-how-many.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: That's the dilemma war always puts in front of me. It may seem like a choice, but it's not. It's an inviolable rule.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: But you still made the call.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I had no choice. If I didn't, all our efforts would've gone to waste. We would've faced defeat. That's why I chose to accept the rules.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: It's a sad thing, seeing a man you used to admire get reshaped by the rules and logic of war.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You even remember what you used to be like? Before you had any part in the Revolutionary War?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Do you remember the man who was always carrying the scriptures as he travelled everywhere, promising to use the gun in his hand to end all conflict and injustice?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Of course I do, Woody. I remember what I was like, and I remember what you were like, too.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: You always had a brush with you. You wanted to have one of your paintings decorate a chapel dome one day.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Have you so much as touched a brush these past years?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: No... Not since I had to get four fingers reattached.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: The target is turning left. She's walking pretty slow. Nearby members, prepare to take her in.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: These coordinates... They're just up ahead. Hurry, Liskarm.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Phew... W-Wait.
The two turn into an alley and stop in their tracks. The girl's lonely back suddenly appears before them.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica...
Hearing her name, the girl turns around.
When she notices who they are, a hint of joy appears on her face, only to be quickly replaced by a sense of helplessness and panic.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: C-Captain... You two came?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yeah, we got your coordinates, so we rushed over here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm sorry, Captain... I'm not sure there's any cleaning up this mess I made.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I approved your application to withdraw from the team, so strictly speaking, I'm not your captain anymore.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Right... I guess that's true. You two must be here to capture me, then.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: No... We're here as your friends.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I got a transmission on our way here. Supposedly, during the explosion, Leone... Well, I'm not sure if you knew, but regardless, I thought you'd probably want someone at your side.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Yeah... I knew. I was on a call with him right until the moment it blew up... Thanks. Thanks for coming. It's just...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Are you okay, Jessica?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I'm not okay. I'm awful.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Do you want us to come over and give you a hug?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No... don't. If you have anything to say, you can say it from there... I can hear you clearly from this distance.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Jessica...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Stay there and don't move, Franka.
Flustered, Jessica pulls her gun from her waist to stop Franka from advancing.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Are... Are you going to point your gun at me?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: S-Sorry... I... I just... Franka, don't... Just leave me alone.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Jessica...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Let me talk to her.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Is there anywhere you want to go, Jessica? After this is all over?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Where could I go...? Those drones have been following me this whole time. You two shouldn't have come... Once you get back, you'll have to explain all these things you won't be able to answer. I'm scared. I'm terrified.

spans.text: I go...? Those drones have been following me this whole time. You two shouldn't have come... Once you get back, you'll have to explain all these things you won't be able to answer. I'm scared. I'm terrified.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't worry about that. If I can't explain it, then so be it. As long as we're all together, there's nothing to worry about. Don't be afraid.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But I am... I'm so, so afraid.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What are you afraid of?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That the pristine pool of water could be too warm, too wonderful.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Uh... I'm not sure I'm following you there...
Suddenly, the headlights of a transport point straight at Jessica, and she is enveloped and imprisoned by a number of giant halos.
The girl's eyes are unable to bear such intense light. All she can do is hold her gun with one arm, and shield her eyes with the other.
After a short while, she seems to have adjusted to the brightness. She puts her arm down, and stares into the distance at the convoy of cars driving toward her.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: How's life treated you all these years?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: In my decades on the frontier, I kept my distance from crowds and wandered around alone a herd of burdenbeasts.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Why didn't you go back to the Holy City?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Didn't want to. What about you? Why didn't you go back?

spans.text: Didn't want to. What about you? Why didn't

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I'm a mercenary. Laterano has no place for me. So why didn't you want to go?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Ain't nothing so unpleasant it can't be forgotten in Laterano.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: But most of the POWs died in that camp. Hardly anyone still remembers. But someone's gotta.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Yet here you are, living the kind of peaceful life you say you reject. Day after day, year after year.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: But I ain't never forgot. I still remember them, to this day.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I've always known there would come a day when you came settle the score.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I just never thought it would take so long.

steps.name: Communicator
steps.text: We've surrounded the target. Repeat, we've surrounded the target.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Drop your weapon, Miss Brynley... weapons. This is the end of the road.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Look around you. There's nowhere to run. This charade is over. The snowstorm is only going to get stronger... Dammit, I was supposed to get off work early today, and catch up on my beauty sleep.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...I do want to apologize to everybody again, but after everything I've said today... it would probably come across as disingenuous.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Don't worry, you'll be fine. The company's making a huge ruckus out of this, but everyone here knows that nothing's going to happen to you.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I heard about you not long after I joined the company, Miss Brynley. Everyone warned me not to get on your bad side, because your family has more lawyers than we've got mercs here today.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Probably even more than you're thinking.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: See? You even realize it yourself. Worst case, you'll get maybe a year or two of jail time. Then you'll be released, and get to live the kinda life you want to again.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Could you put down the amplifier? It's unnecessary at this distance.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: What, after I brought it all this way?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm begging you. Shut up.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Sure, if you've got a better idea for how to persuade her.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: It's fine, Liskarm. You don't need to defend me. I know how everyone sees me.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Right. It seems like ever since I was a kid, I've never thought about the consequences before I did anything. Because no matter what, my family would take care of the mess. That's probably why I come off as selfish.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But that's not how it's supposed to go. There's always a price. And when you make a hasty, rash decision, you have to bear the consequences.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica... You said you'd thought this all through when you asked to leave the team.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: No. I'm not talking about tonight. I'm talking about when I arrived at Fort Barron seven years ago. When I first walked through those huge doors.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: At first, I only wanted to be a tester at the Equipment and Applied Technology Department. I never imagined that one day I'd be standing on a real battlefield, pointing my weapon at a real person.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Right, that's where the root of the problem lies. We often pick up our weapons without considering the price that needs to be paid.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Take this little handgun for example. I can hold it up with just two hands. I can pull the trigger with just one finger. I learned how to use it in less than a month.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: What's even more scary is that... I'd need only a second to take somebody's life with it.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But it would take me a lifetime to forget that one second.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: See? That's how foolish I was. Before I picked it up, I never even considered who I would point it at in the future.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...But I'd already fired my first shot. Not fully thinking this through would be unforgivable.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Have you thought it through, then?

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Because you've been holding your gun up this whole time. Hell, you haven't lowered it for even a second.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: How arrogant. When did I ever say I came to settle a score with you?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You think I brought this bullet here for revenge?

spans.text: You think I brought this bullet here for

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Are you telling me you're not stuck in the past?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: No. You're the one who's stuck.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You lived to your nineties as a merc. Can you really adjust to any kinda life outside the battlefield?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Woody. The reason I'm still unwilling to leave the battlefield is because war never ends.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Columbia's war ended a long time ago.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: It did, but then Bolívar's war began right on its heels. Victoria's war may have calmed down for the moment, but there's no stopping the fallout it's started.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: War is always here. It merely takes a break every now and then, before erupting somewhere else.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Then why stay on the battlefield? To be continually baptized by the flames of war?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Because if I can never end war, I have to settle for the next best thing. To hold its on-off switch in my hands.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: That's why I started Blacksteel.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: But can you really control it?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I've tried plenty of times, and I paid a dear price. But I did it in the end.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Was it worth it?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Even if all I can manage is to put it on pause for a few seconds, that's more than enough time for countless people like you to pick up their brushes again.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Then why can't you put what you're doing here on pause too?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I'm sure a few seconds to breathe would be plenty for folks like me, gasping for air. Sure beats getting pathetically run off to the frontier.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Because Davistown is no battlefield.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I can't put it down, because... this is the only thing I have left that still has power.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: All these years, I've thought of myself as something like a blank white symbol...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: The wealth, family, and influence it represents... mean nothing. They have no use in the face of the problems I want to solve.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But with this in my hand... at least I accomplished something.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: With this in my hand, at least I'm not a completely useless symbol.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Nonsense.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Captain...?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Jessica, it's been five years. In these five years, have you ever once thought about why I picked you as my assistant?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: This is Blacksteel we're talking about... There are all kinds of amazing people here. But I still chose you. And not because of that gun you're holding, but because of your tears.

spans.text: This is Blacksteel we're talking about... There are all kinds of amazing people here. But I still chose
. And not because of that gun you're holding, but because of your tears.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Tears... but tears of weakness can't protect the people behind me.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Tears don't imply weakness. The work we do at B.P.R.S is dirty, tiresome, and dangerous. No one does this kind of work just for the money.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Only someone who's able to empathize with the pain of others can throw herself into a cause for a group of strangers, or a place she barely knows.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Captain... Just when I thought I was completely useless, you brought me into your team.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: That was the first time in my life I ever felt appreciated, and I still remember that feeling.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: To repay your trust, I would willingly brave hell and high water.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: But you shouldn't... You shouldn't walk that path. No one's journey should be to earn someone's else's recognition.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Do whatever it is that you yourself really want to do. Do what truly makes you happy. You don't need anybody's recognition except your own, deep in your heart.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Captain... I... I really want to cry right now...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Then cry. Let your tears flow. No need to hold back.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Woody, your halo is flashing.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You're goddamn right it is. I want to kill you.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You keep saying that war never ends, that all you can do is control it.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: But you're wrong. War can be ended. Just not by you.

spans.text: be ended. Just not by you.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: War is ended by countless ordinary folks. Folks who've been encroached on by it, but like weeds try their hardest to survive.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Everywhere that's ever burned down in the flames of war has always been fixed up by untold numbers of normal folks, trying their best to get back the lives they used to live. Even in the most dire of circumstances.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You should've died on the battlefield. Would've been a much better fate than becoming the war-obsessed madman you are now.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: At first, I just wanted to return the bullet to you. But now, I really wanna kill you.
A strong gale lifts up the old man's hat and tosses it into the air.
But he neither looks up nor moves to grab it.
His eyes, not blinking for even a moment, are fixed on the man standing opposite him. All his muscles, from his cheek to his neck, are as tense as can be.
And above his head, his halo is flashing rapidly.
The man opposite him keeps silent for a time, then gradually takes a deep breath. As though it is only through the sound of the roaring winds that he can understand the old man's words.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Well then. Do you know who it is you're going to kill?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Your nemesis? Your friend who betrayed you? Or a complete madman?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: None of the above. It's an arrogant dick who looks down on everything.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: In his eyes, everything can be weighed on scales. And to achieve his goals, he's capable of sacrificing anything.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: ...What about you, then? What kind of man will shoot me with that bullet?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: An ordinary man.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: A ordinary man who lost everything except his anger when you looked down on him.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Very good.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: What's so funny?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: That finger of yours always yearned to hold a brush, but in the end, you'll use it to pull the trigger. My hands yearned to hold scriptures, but in the end, they'll be drenched in blood.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: It's just funny how fate makes fools of us all.
The wind lifts Cliff's coat, revealing both the firearm on his waist and the hand reaching for it.
Through the flurry of snow, he sees Woodrow doing the same.

He suddenly remembers how, all those years ago in Laterano, on the way back to the dorm, a gust of wind blew Woodrow's hat away and carried it into the sky. And for a very long time, it stayed up there.
Years have come and gone, and now that hat in the wind has finally landed back on the ground.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: You can see my tears...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But what about them?

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Them? Who?
Jessica doesn't give him an answer. She merely looks back at the desolate mine. After the explosion, it looks all the more devastated.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Sir, do you know what that used to look like?

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I don't.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Well, I do...

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I know there was a time when the energy tower burned endlessly to bring warmth to the residents here.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I know there was a time when that diner never closed. Everyone would gather around the tables over beer and sing to their hearts' content.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I know the winters here are long and cold, but with their dedication and hard work, every last person who lived here filled this place with light and warmth.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Their fierce, brilliant light enveloped every inch of this place to drive out the frigid cold and darkness of the winter nights.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: They turned their bustling everyday life into burning red blood, and injected it into this plate frozen by the long winter, giving it life and vitality.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: They were people whose path was uncertain, but insisted on walking it nonetheless.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: They were people who were cruelly tormented by life here, their necks bent under its weight. Even then, they lived here amid the snowstorm.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: They... were people who shed tears, but no one ever noticed.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: My tears... can't stand in for their sadness.
The girl raises her gun, and through its sight she sees an array of faces.
Some look confused, some disapproving, some stunned, some dazed. Some are chuckling, some are lamenting.
But their faces are not important. They quickly enter the girl's eyes, and exit them just as fast, never stopping in her heart for a moment.
Instead, a few other faces appear in her mind.
The girl who prayed in the tent.
The woman who scampered away in the snowfield.
The old man who drew his gun in the dark night.
The man who departed in flames.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: But my gun will cry for their sorrow.
She raises her arm up high toward the sky, and fires all her bullets in one go.
As the snow thrashes through the air, the empty casings fall to the ground, melting the snowdrifts away with their lingering heat.
The gunshots reverberate in the air for a long time. Before silence returns to her surroundings, the girl's ears catch a faint, feeble sound.
It's the sound of her tears smashing into the earth.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Huff...

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: You lose.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Sorry, Woody. I chose war. I chose never-ending war.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: So... my life is like a bullet. An explosion that can't be stopped. A siege and a defense with no end in sight.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: I can't end war, but you can end me.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Only when the last soldier fighting it falls, can the war finally end.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Rupert...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Now there's a name I haven't heard... in a long time.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Thanks, Woody, for still being willing to say that name. Aside from you, there's not a single person who remembers it.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Goodbye...
Cliff closes his eyes and waits for the bullet to tear his forehead apart.
But before that, he hears a ringtone.
He pulls out his communicator, takes a look, and chuckles. Then he puts it back into his pocket.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Who was it?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: The military.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Go on.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Is it Bolívar... or Victoria?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Nothing you need to worry about, Woody.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Is it Columbia?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Do it!

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Another war is about to start, isn't it?

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...Where will it affect this time?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: A forewarning, perhaps. It's not set in stone.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Give it to me.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Woody, a lot of the things I have on here are just trivial, everyday matters to me. But to you...

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: They'd be a whole new nightmare.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...Hand it over.

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: If you insist. Feast your eyes on them.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: Who'll take all this over once you're dead?

steps.name: 'Clip' Cliff
steps.text: Someone.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: ...They shouldn't.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: There shouldn't be nobody else like you.
He throws the communicator to the ground and shoots it full of holes.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: I can't kill you.

steps.name: Woodrow
steps.text: This sin is yours to bear.
Woodrow sets his gun down on the floor and raises his hands.
Behind him, attracted by the sound of gunfire, a crowd of mercenaries surges into the area with frantic footsteps and moves to surround him.
In the sky, the last few snowflakes of the night are fluttering down.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Okay guys, take me away. I'm ready.
The girl holsters her firearm, and lifts her hands above her head.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Put your hands behind your back.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ...Handcuffs don't feel as cold as I thought they would.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Because I've been keeping them warm this whole time.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Thank you...

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: Can I have a word with you before we go?

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: I should thank you too, sir. Thanks for listening to all that.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: It's fine... Before you, there was another guy who jabbered away just as much, if not more.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: I'm sure... he'd be happy that you remembered what he said.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: Oh... You knew him, too.

steps.name: Calm Blacksteel Mercenary
steps.text: He was a good kid. Hard to forget once you've met him... Goodbye, Jessica.
The mercenary taps the girl's shoulder, raising a cloud of dust as the sun rises, and turns around to leave.
As Jessica gazes at the floating dust under the sunlight, she suddenly realizes that the night has already passed.
Likewise, the snowstorm had subsided at some point.

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ♪She spread her arms, spread her heart, showed me that pretty face♪

steps.name: Jessica
steps.text: ♪And from that moment on, I found my dreams in her embrace♪
